execution_escalation.scope: Every consequential Naya/NayaPOWER/MAXIS execution, debugging cycle, investigation, verification cycle, and recovery attempt.

resolution_rules: Resolve canonical identity before repository search.
Resolve the canonical source map before interpreting overlapping documents.
Historical/superseded names are aliases, never current locators.
Current repository HEAD is authoritative over recorded HEAD claims.
UNKNOWN cannot satisfy VERIFIED or RACE_READY.
A block cannot be VERIFIED without appropriate evidence.
One highest-value next action must be exposed for the current block.

After ten materially equivalent attempts without a material strategy change, treat the condition as RED ALERT and require a materially different route or documented human-authorized exception.
